speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your appointment. I am Dr. Agent, and since you are a newborn, I will be asking your parents to help me understand your health. To begin, how long has your baby been breathing fast or working hard to breathe, and have you noticed any color changes like turning blue?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia (CDH). The history of no prenatal care combined with immediate respiratory distress and potential cyanosis is highly suggestive of this condition, which requires immediate confirmation via X-ray showing bowel loops in the thoracic cavity.
